name: THF riboswitch bound to folinic acid (FFO)
notes: THF (tetrahydrofolate) riboswitch from Eubacterium siraeum (1.95 Å). Ligand FFO is (6S)-5-formyl-tetrahydrofolate (folinic acid, MW 473). Pteridine ring stacks on nucleobase; aminobenzoyl tail makes H-bonds. High-resolution single-chain case — good for scoring calibration. Ref: Serganov et al. 2012 Nat Chem Biol.
